{{Quote|It's a sleepy little backwater. Edge of the galaxy. Not important. Idyllic. Quiet little place.|[[Raze (criminal)|Raze]]|<ref name="Rebellion 6">[[Rebellion 6|''Rebellion'' 6]]</ref>}}
'''Ahakista''' was a pleasure [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Myto sector/Legends|Myto sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] circa [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], Ahakista remained distant from galactic politicking for several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], already embroiled in its own conflicts on-planet. It wasn't until the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that war began to broil in its space. It was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-controlled space during the war.<ref name="TEA" />

Annexed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Imperials constructed the [[Pyramid One]] complex with the support of the upper classes. Abolishing the [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]] that had stabilized the world for centuries, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] incited a [[civil war]] by organizing the planet's elite to take control of the government in order to consolidate power. Hearing rumors of the construction of Pyramid One, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] dispatched commandos to thwart the Empire's activities on Ahakista, but lacked any real strength. After many failed plots, the rebels garnered the support of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Raze (criminal)|Raze]], who agreed to provide agents capable of destroying [[The Hub (computer)|The Hub]].

After the fall of the Empire at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] organized a large area of space containing Ahakista into [[Oversector Outer]]. Later consolidated into the [[Pentastar Alignment]] by [[Ardus Kaine]], the area became the heart of [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon's]] Imperial Remnant after signing a treaty with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. All went well on Ahakista for a time, until the horrors of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] were unleashed upon the world. Devastated by the war, the Remnant attempted to mend its member states who were in need.<ref name="TEA" />

As of [[137 ABY]], the Myto sector remained aligned to the [[Fel Empire]]-in-Exile.<ref name="TEA" />

==Geography==
A remote planet in the Outer Rim, Ahakista was temperate with an arid landscape. No one paid it much attention, which was why the Empire established a secret outpost on the planet during the years leading up to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was believed that the facility known as The Hub would be safer from terrorism on a world like Ahakista, since it was far enough from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to avoid notice, yet close enough to allow for regular transmissions of data.
